description: Create a new Data Store in OneUptime. Returns the created Data Store object with its ID. Use this to add new Data Stores to your project. Note: projectId is inferred from your API key — you do not need to provide it.

connectionString.description: For a database scanned by OneUptime's workers: a read-only connection string. Encrypted at rest and never returned by the API.
connectionString.example: This is an example of very long text content that might be stored in this field. It can contain a lot of information, such as detailed descriptions, comments, or any other lengthy text data that needs to be stored in the database.

description.description: What the store is for, in your team's words.
description.example: This is an example of longer text content that might be stored in this field.

environment.description: Which environment the store serves: Production, Staging, Development, Test or Unknown. Read from its tags and name; people may set it.

isAiData.description: The store holds data used to train or ground an AI model.

isContentScanEnabled.description: Whether Data Security samples the store's content. Configuration checks run either way.

isPublicByDesign.description: The store is meant to be public, such as a website's assets. Public access checks pass for it.

kind.description: What kind of store it is: an S3 bucket, an RDS instance, a PostgreSQL database, a service's logs.

labels.description: Relation to Labels Array where this object is categorized in.

name.description: The store's name: a bucket, database, dataset or service name.
name.example: This is an example of longer text content that might be stored in this field.

probeConnectionVariable.description: For a database scanned from a probe: the environment variable on that probe that holds its connection string. The connection string itself never reaches OneUptime.

projectId.description: ID of the project this data store belongs to.

purpose.description: Why the store holds personal data, for the GDPR record of processing.
purpose.example: This is an example of longer text content that might be stored in this field.

retention.description: How long data is kept in the store, for the GDPR record of processing.

scanExclusions.description: Path prefixes, tables or attribute keys the content scan skips.

scanProbeId.description: A probe that scans the store's content from inside your network instead of OneUptime's workers.

sensitivityOverride.description: A sensitivity people set by hand, which the store is treated as instead of what the scans found.

name: create_data_store
title: Create Data Store
